approvalScope: Exact product projection delta and specified test diagnostics only. This is not runtime, whole-AC, QA, story, or lifecycle approval.

concreteObservations.detail: Exact byte comparison equals archive with only the three-line conditional secretId copy removed. Zero added lines; no formatting delta. inputId, sourceStepId, kind, intendedSlot remain the positive-field model input projection. Internal materialized authored inputs and their secretId are not edited by this change.

inputs.items remains closed with additionalProperties=false and exactly four required approved fields. kind still permits secretRef and its intendedSlot remains fill.value. The removed secretId property was incompatible with this existing model-input schema.

Unchanged classifier emits secretRef configurationReferences with referenceName and no value. Unchanged assembler masks secret-token spans and forwards configurationReferences, retaining approved reference identifiers while safeInputs excludes values. Unchanged GuidedModelProjection validates v3/planning-context before copying. No privacy/schema guard was relaxed.

Test-only @Primary RunnerDispatchClient wraps the concrete HttpRunnerDispatchClient: one actual.send(job) per send and one actual.cancel(executionId) per cancel, returning the actual outcome; send RuntimeException is rethrown. No job serialization, raw body, detail string, secret value, or exception message is retained. Outcome fields are enum/boolean/closed reason and classified HTTP status. Exception metadata uses bounded class/method/line frames and allowlisted SQL state; these structural frame strings are not a finite code enum.

The generated ordinary worker saves ServerResponse.prototype.end and calls it exactly once using Reflect.apply with unchanged receiver/arguments before inspecting a 409. The original return value is returned. Original synchronous errors propagate before witness logic; witness failures are caught. No status/header/body/arguments/callback/result mutation and no new HTTP call are introduced by the tap.

The only persisted tap witness is status=409, code in PROFILE_MISMATCH/AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED/POLICY_REFUSED/REFERENCE_REFUSED/OTHER, and process-monotonic elapsed milliseconds. Exact string/Buffer equality classifies the existing response; no parsing, arbitrary code extraction, raw chunk copy/persistence, or closure retention occurs. append uses mode 0600. The hook covers 409 ends within the generated ordinary process; it is not correlated to an execution ID.

All nine @Test method bodies, including their assertions, are byte-identical to the verified 8c69 archive. Helpers/configuration changed for diagnostics; unchanged assertion bodies do not prove runtime equivalence or passing outcomes.

limits: Static inspection and byte comparison only; no tests, Gradle, build, browser, runtime, or model execution performed.
No determination of the actual ordinary HTTP409 refusal code or resolution; the witness is diagnostic capability, not runtime evidence.
Existing passing service9/producer9/native8 and unfinished all19/full-ten-story acceptance status were not independently rerun or approved.

The Java diagnostic map operations are not isolated by a best-effort logging guard: an instrumentation failure could interfere with returning/rethrowing. No such failure is evidenced here; exact noninterference under arbitrary diagnostic failures is not certified.
The ordinary witness introduces synchronous local file I/O after end and can affect timing; alternate response chunking falls back to OTHER. It adds no remote calls.
Classpath resource equality was read from existing build/resources bytes; no fresh build or loaded-process classpath certification.
Archived-path comparisons do not certify unarchived additions or the entire working tree.
